text: A psalm of David. I will sing of lovingkindness and justice. To You, ADONAI, I will sing praises.
I will behave wisely in the way of integrity — when will You come to me? I walk in my house with integrity in my heart.
No base thing will I set before my eyes. Twisted behavior I hate — it will not cling to me.
A perverse heart will depart from me. I will know nothing evil.
Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret — him I will silence. Who has haughty eyes and a proud heart — him I will not tolerate.
My eyes are on the trustworthy of the land, to be in my company. One walking in a blameless way will serve me.
No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house. No one who utters lies will endure before my eyes.
Each morning I silence all the land’s wicked ones — to cut off from ADONAI’s city every evildoer.
